J_CB.provenance: NeelNanda/pile-10k first 25 docs, target_layer 62, t_max 128, skip_first 4, estimator standard

contract.prompt: An activation vector from layer {layer} of a language model is enclosed in activation tags: <activation>{char}</activation>. Produce distinct concepts that encode this activation, each as a '- ' bullet on its own line.
contract.injection: replace the input-embedding row of the marker token with alpha * h/||h||
contract.marker_scan: U+3200..U+33FF, first char that is one token in the full chat render

contract.injection: Karvonen norm-matched ADD at the output of block 1 at the marker token: h' = h + ||h|| * v/||v|| (EasyNLA nla/injection.py karvonen_inject_in_residual)
contract.ar_read: output of the last (43rd) block at the last prompt token, final norm removed; pred = value_head(normalize(h, sqrt(d)))
contract.fve: paper definition: 1 - mean((n(pred) - n(gold))^2) / mean((n(v) - mean n(v))^2) over a reference set, n = scale to L2 norm sqrt(d)

nla_reference_activations.use: 64 layer-42 activations of the NLA training corpus; FVE denominator for single-cell smoke tests
